metadata.title: High-Contrast Profile Portrait with Minimalist Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, high-contrast black and white profile portrait of a man, where the face is largely in deep shadow, set against a bright, slightly textured light background. A single line of horizontal text sits at the center-left, intersecting the neck area.
coreVisualRelationships: Extreme contrast between the deep black silhouette and the bright white background
Horizontal text line acting as a visual bridge across the vertical silhouette
Subtle highlights on the ear and collar defining form within the darkness
coreInvariants: Monochrome palette with a single vibrant accent color
Grainy, film-like texture in the highlights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale profile occupying the left two-thirds of the frame, cropped at the chest.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The sharp edge of the profile's nose and lips against the bright background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the dark silhouette, follows the profile edge downward to the text, then moves horizontally across the type.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant bright negative space on the right side balances the heavy dark mass on the left.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black for the subject silhouette and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white/light grey for the background and highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant purple for the secondary text element.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast (0 to 100) with zero saturation in the image and high saturation in the accent text.

composition.overlap: Partially over the silhouette, partially over the background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family with color-based hierarchy to distinguish between primary and secondary information.

preserve: Horizontal placement across the neck line

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, geometric, and compact nature of the original type.
Provides a similar weight and verticality.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, black and white profile photograph of a man facing right. The face should be in deep shadow (silhouette) with only subtle highlights on the ear and collar. The background should be a bright, slightly grainy white studio wall.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of condensed sans-serif text horizontally across the center-left, positioned where the neck meets the background. Use white for the first word and a vibrant purple for the remaining text.

verificationChecks: Is the contrast between the subject and background extreme?
Is the text perfectly horizontal and centered vertically relative to the head?
Is the purple color vibrant and saturated?
Is the grain texture visible in the white areas?

adjustableVariables: Exact hue of the purple accent
Position of the text line (higher or lower on the neck)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individual
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the silhouette is solid black without internal detail except for the ear highlight.
Check that the text is legible against both the black and white backgrounds.
Verify the grain does not obscure the sharpness of the profile edge.
Confirm the composition remains minimalist and uncluttered.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast silhouette + bright textured background + single-line condensed sans-serif text with color split.
